body: You can use either: ```js { templates: '{{name}}...' } ``` Then ```css .list-group-item[data-facet-value="facet value"] { } ``` So that you do not even have to do a mapping between facet names and "safe css" class/id. Would that work? Otherwise, you can use `transformData: function () {}` which allows you to modify the data passed to the template and you could generate your css safe name here.
